title: No Thunderbolt/USB4 controller
detail: This machine has no Thunderbolt or USB4 domain, so a Thunderbolt eGPU cannot attach. An OCuLink eGPU still shows up as a removable PCI device.

title: thunderbolt is not in the initramfs
detail: Loading it early lets an enclosure attached at boot come up before the desktop.

title: eGPU driver does not load at boot
detail: No modules-load.d file loads a backend module.

title: mkinitcpio does not add the eGPU driver
eGPU driver in the initramfs
detail: lsinitcpio is not installed. Do not rebuild the initramfs with the eGPU attached.

title: NVIDIA module options
detail: No 'options nvidia-drm modeset=1'. It is the default on 580xx, but nothing pins it.

title: nouveau is not blacklisted
detail: nouveau could claim the eGPU before nvidia on hot-plug.

title: nvidia-drm not loaded
detail: It loads when the eGPU is connected; the live value is checked then.

title: NVIDIA driver not installed
detail: Only needed for an NVIDIA eGPU. Install the 580xx (closed) or open dkms package that matches the card.

title: NVIDIA sleep units not enabled
detail: With the eGPU attached during suspend, VRAM contents may be lost. They are not needed after an eject.

title: GPU links are not installed
detail: /dev/dri/omarchy-egpu-primary and -external pin the GPU order without cardN numbers (primary is pci-0000:00:02.0-card). They come with the udev rule. Optional with the igpu policy: the laptop GPU is primary by itself.

title: The toggle file is missing
detail: /tmp/omarchy-egpu-fixtures.sQZ5Vs/stranger-no-tb/home/.local/state/omarchy/toggles/hypr/zz-omarchy-egpu.lua keeps the session's GL, EGL and video decode on the Intel GPU while the eGPU is attached (policy igpu).

fix.label: Write the toggle file (omarchy-egpu display apply)

title: vulkaninfo is not installed
detail: Connect uses it to check that Vulkan sees the eGPU; without it that check is skipped.

title: The system half is not installed
detail: Connect, eject and rescan need /usr/local/bin/omarchy-egpu-admin and its polkit action.
